title: Black Sea Grain Initiative: corridor exports and global food-price context

rationale: The United Nations published a monthly series of grain and foodstuff exports under the Initiative, including a clear partial-period marker for July 2023.
FAO provides a monthly global food-price dataset and commodity-group indices that can be aligned as contextual outcomes after the exact CSV is captured.
The case provides a concrete test of event, physical-flow and outcome evidence without requiring us to invent a supplier graph.
case_selection.selection_limit: This is not yet a qualified analytical case. Source bytes, exact query snapshots, a trade-flow baseline, controls and independent review remain outstanding.

time_windows.caveat: The proposed 2017-2021 trade baseline spans the COVID-19 period and is not a sufficient control on its own. Seasonality, the pandemic, other exporters, policy changes and other simultaneous shocks must be considered before defining controls.

published_source_findings.interpretation_ceiling: Publication-reported Initiative flows only; not a complete measure of Ukrainian exports by all routes and not an independently captured dataset.

candidate_sources.role: Direct corridor mechanism observation: monthly Initiative exports and voyages.
candidate_sources.required_next_step: Acquire/capture the official source response or downloadable table under permitted terms; record exact bytes, SHA-256, access time, parser version and reconcile all monthly values to the reported total.

candidate_sources.role: Monthly global food-price context; separately inspect cereal and vegetable-oil group indices.
candidate_sources.required_next_step: Acquire exact monthly CSV, record its bytes/hash/version and attribution/terms; identify series definitions, revision policy, date semantics and missing values.

candidate_sources.role: Conflict context only, using a pinned version and codebook; never as proof that a port or route was closed.
candidate_sources.required_next_step: Capture GED version 26.1 and its codebook if the chosen event question requires it; record exact hashes, citations and version. The browser reader did not ingest the ZIP archive, so no raw file is claimed.

candidate_sources.role: Potential country/partner/product/monthly trade baseline for HS 1001 wheat and HS 1005 maize; dimensions are not exact shipments.
candidate_sources.required_next_step: Freeze the intended reporter/partner/flow/product/classification/month dimensions and check API entitlement, coverage, page/preview limits, valuation and source terms before requesting data.

candidate_sources.role: Optional maritime-activity corroboration and alternative-route context, not commodity-specific shipment truth.
candidate_sources.required_next_step: Add only if an exact collection offers relevant coverage and the data definition, source vintage, geography and terms can be reviewed.

preregistered_questions: Can the reported monthly Initiative exports be captured and independently reconciled to the publisher's reported cumulative total?
How do the Initiative's corridor-specific observed flows evolve over its own operating period, including the explicitly partial final month?
How do those observations line up in time with captured FAO cereal and vegetable-oil indices, without claiming the flow series caused global price movements?

Can a separately captured monthly trade baseline help distinguish Initiative shipments from Ukraine's all-route exports, and can usable control series be found without incompatible classifications or source coverage?
prohibited_claims: Do not infer zero Ukrainian grain exports before the Initiative's monthly series begins.
Do not treat Initiative shipments as all Ukrainian exports or as inventory available to a destination market.
Do not treat July 2023 as a complete monthly period; the source table ends on 14 July.
Do not attribute global food-price changes causally to the Initiative based on time-series alignment.
Do not interpret UCDP conflict events, PortWatch activity, or proximity to ports as direct closure evidence.
Do not advance the case to a qualified analysis while exact source bytes, rights review and independent controls remain incomplete.
